messages:
Sam Warren: FYI: we're doing the GitHub SSO + CI token migration this Thursday 09:00 PT. This replaces long-lived PATs with short-lived OIDC tokens and a `ci-service` account for non-workflow automation. Read runbook: https://runbook.internal/redwood/oidc-cutover :loud_sound:
Jess Li: Thanks. Do we have a short checklist for repo owners?
Sam Warren: Yes 1: - search for `GH_TOKEN`/`GITHUB_PAT` in workflows and replace with OIDC approach or `ci-service` secrets; 2: update self-hosted runner configs to use org OIDC where applicable; 3: run the preflight tests (we'll announce list). See runbook section "owner-checklist".
Maria Gomez: Will the automation that opens Jira tickets from CI still work?
Sam Warren: If it uses a GitHub App or the `automation-bot` service account, no change. If it directly calls GH API with a PAT, migrate to OIDC or proxy through `automation-bot`. Examples in runbook.
Infra Bot: infra-playbook triggered: infra/sa-rotation (owner: infra-team)
A J: I'm scheduling a 1h preflight Tue 16:00 PT covering dev + playground + internal-sdk. Volunteers to monitor logs? :eyes:
Jess Li: I'll be there. Can we get the exact curl snippet to test token exchange?
Sam Warren: Example (run on a runner):
```
# request OIDC token from STS
curl -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"audience":"https://token.redwood.ai","repository":"redwood/internal-sdk"}' https://sts.internal.redwood/get-oidc-token
```
Sam Warren: If you need a short extension for a repo, file a ticket in #help with repo name + owner. We'll be pragmatic but aim to close the tail within 48h post-cut.
